text.en: These Notification may be cited as the Census (Direction To Take Census) Notification. Direction.

It is hereby directed that a census of population and housing be taken throughout Brunei Darussalam from the commencement of this Notification, in order to ascertain the social, civil and economic condition of the inhabitants of the country. Available from $4.00 Attorney General’s Chambers The Law Building, Jalan Tutong SUBSIDIARY LEGISLATION Bandar Seri Begawan BA1910 CAP. 78, 2003 Ed. Brunei Darussalam Printed by The Government Printing Department Brunei Darussalam
